instruction: A candid full shot of an indoor dance studio with a wooden floor. On the right, the woman in the red dress (R1) stands with her back to the camera, holding her partner. On the left, the man in the striped polo (R2) faces right, lifting his left foot slightly as they step together in a dance routine. They are in a close dance hold. The background shows a tripod and plain walls. Warm indoor lighting illuminates the dancers, casting soft shadows on the floor.

R2 faces right and lifts his left foot slightly as they step together
R1 and R2 are in a close dance hold
